messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — planning to tag rc/v1.8.0-rc1 at 14:00 PT (≈2h). I will soft-freeze master at 13:45 PT. Please shout if you need a version bump or a changelog line added.

maria: Can we push cutoff 30m later? I have a tiny docs fix that should go in.

alex: If it's docs-only (no code), that's fine. For code changes I need them in and green by 13:30 PT. Docs-only can land until 14:00.

jang: Quick question on cherry-picks: infra/networking PRs — are those allowed for RC? There's one small NAT change that would help the canary.

alex: We should avoid infra churn unless it's a critical regression or fixes canary breakage. If you think it's critical, post the PR & test logs here and @sre-oncall will triage.

kevin: Canary window? What's the plan for monitoring and rollback?

alex: Plan is 2h canary starting at 14:30 PT with weighted traffic 10% -> 50% if green. Rollback policy: revert to previous tag and scale down new canary if error rate > 1% or p95 latency increases > 25%.

ci-bot: CI status: runtime-integration (flaky) — 2 failing tests (test-kv-cache, test-batching). Blocking tag until green.

alex: Acknowledged. I'll re-run the failing pipeline now. If still flaky, we'll isolate and approve with explicit override from @kevin + @maria.

alex: Quick ping: @maria @jang please review/approve PRs #4567 (changelog + docs) and #4572 (minor tokenizer tweak). Need approvals to tag.

maria: Reviewing #4567 now. small wording nit, will fix and approve. :thumbsup:

jang: Skimmed #4572 — looks ok. Left one comment but not blocking. Approving after CI green.

ci-bot: CI re-run complete: runtime-integration now green. All checks passing.

alex: Nice. Tagging in 10. Command I'm going to use:

```
\ngit checkout -b release/v1.8.0-rc1
\ngit tag -a v1.8.0-rc1 -m "RC v1.8.0"
\ngit push origin v1.8.0-rc1
\n```

alex: Draft announcement for #announcements — please quick edit: 

"Heads up: We're cutting RC v1.8.0-rc1 at 14:00 PT. Expect a 2h canary starting ~14:30 PT (10% -> 50% traffic). Watch: latency and error-rate dashboards. If you see issues, ping @sre-oncall. Rollback criteria: error rate >1% or p95 latency +25%."

kevin: Add a short note about API compatibility and migration docs link. Also include ETA for full rollout if canary is green (aiming for 24h).

maria: Add bullet about changelog link and that this RC includes the tokenizer bugfix in #4572.

alex: Updated draft — will post to #announcements at tag time. Thanks everyone for quick turns.

sre-oncall: I'll be watching dashboards during canary and coordinate rollback if needed.
